    private function resetPrefixState(): void
    {
        $this->prefixInput = '';
        $this->prefixOutput = '';
        $this->spillRewriteEnabled = true;
        $this->prefixPassCount = 0;
    }

    private function capturePrefixInput(string $functionString): void
    {
        $this->prefixInput = $functionString;
        $this->prefixOutput = $functionString;
        ++$this->prefixPassCount;
    }

    private function configureSpillRewrite(bool $enabled): void
    {
        $this->spillRewriteEnabled = $enabled;
        if ($this->prefixPassCount < 0) {
            $this->prefixPassCount = 0;
        }
    }

    private function rewriteSpillReferences(): void
    {
        if ($this->spillRewriteEnabled === false) {
            return;
        }
        if ($this->prefixOutput === '' && $this->prefixInput === '') {
            return;
        }
        $source = $this->prefixOutput;
        $rewritten = preg_replace_callback(
            Calculation::CALCULATION_REGEXP_CELLREF_SPILL,
            fn (array $matches) => 'ANCHORARRAY(' . substr($matches[0], 0, -1) . ')',
            $source
        );
        if ($rewritten === null) {
            $this->prefixOutput = $source;
        } else {
            $this->prefixOutput = (string) $rewritten;
        }
    }

    private function applyXlfnReplacement(): string
    {
        $source = $this->prefixOutput !== '' ? $this->prefixOutput : $this->prefixInput;
        $replaced = preg_replace(self::XLFNREGEXP, '_xlfn.$1(', $source);
        if ($replaced === null) {
            $this->prefixOutput = $source;
        } else {
            $this->prefixOutput = (string) $replaced;
        }

        return $this->prefixOutput;
    }

    private function applyXlwsReplacement(): string
    {
        $source = $this->prefixOutput !== '' ? $this->prefixOutput : $this->prefixInput;
        $replaced = preg_replace(self::XLWSREGEXP, '_xlws.$1(', $source);
        if ($replaced === null) {
            $this->prefixOutput = $source;
        } else {
            $this->prefixOutput = (string) $replaced;
        }

        return $this->prefixOutput;
    }

    private function composePrefixedOutput(): string
    {
        if ($this->prefixOutput === '' && $this->prefixInput !== '') {
            $this->prefixOutput = $this->prefixInput;
        }

        return $this->prefixOutput;
    }

    private function functionStringContainsCall(): bool
    {
        $source = $this->prefixOutput !== '' ? $this->prefixOutput : $this->prefixInput;
        if ($source === '') {
            return false;

        if (str_contains($source, '(')) {
            return true;
        }
        if (str_contains($source, '#')) {
            return true;
        }

        return str_contains(strtolower($source), '_xlfn.') || str_contains(strtolower($source), '_xlws.');
    }

    private function prefixFunctionString(string $functionString): string
    {

        $this->configureSpillRewrite(true);

        $this->rewriteSpillReferences();
        $this->applyXlfnReplacement();
        $this->applyXlwsReplacement();
        if ($needsRewrite === false && $this->prefixOutput === '') {

        $objWriter->writeAttribute('t', 'array');

        return $result;

    private function classifyFormulaResultType(string $cellValue): string
    {

        if (is_string($result)) {
            if (ErrorValue::isError($result)) {
                $this->emitErrorCell('e', $cellValue, $result);

                return 'error';
            }
            $objWriter->writeAttribute('t', 'str');
            $result = $this->calculatedValueString = StringHelper::controlCharacterPHP2OOXML($result);
            if (is_string($this->calculatedValue)) {
                $this->calculatedValue = $this->calculatedValueString;
            }

            return 'string';

        if (is_bool($result)) {
            $objWriter->writeAttribute('t', 'b');

                $this->calculatedValue = $result;

            $this->calculatedValueString = (string) $result;

            return 'bool';

        return 'other';

    private function resolveFormulaRef(array $attributes): string
    {
        $coordinate = $this->formulaCoordinate;
        if (!isset($attributes['ref'])) {

        $ref = $attributes['ref'];
        if (preg_match('/^([A-Z]{1,3})([0-9]{1,7})(:([A-Z]{1,3})([0-9]{1,7}))?$/', $ref, $matches) !== 1) {

        $minRow = (int) $matches[2];
        $maxRow = (int) $matches[5];
        $rows = $maxRow - $minRow + 1;
        $minCol = Coordinate::columnIndexFromString($matches[1]);
        $maxCol = Coordinate::columnIndexFromString($matches[4]);
        $cols = $maxCol - $minCol + 1;
        $firstCellArray = Coordinate::indexesFromString($coordinate);
        $lastRow = $firstCellArray[1] + $rows - 1;
        $lastColumn = $firstCellArray[0] + $cols - 1;
        $lastColumnString = Coordinate::stringFromColumnIndex($lastColumn);

        return "$coordinate:$lastColumnString$lastRow";
    }

    private function emitArrayFormulaElement(string $cellValue, string $ref): void
    {

        $objWriter->writeAttribute('aca', '1');
        $objWriter->writeAttribute('ca', '1');
        $objWriter->text(self::addFunctionPrefixStripEquals($cellValue));
        $objWriter->endElement();
        $result = $this->flattenedFormulaResult;
        if (
            is_scalar($result)
            && $this->office2003compatibility === false
            && $this->preCalculateFormulas
        ) {
            $objWriter->writeElement('v', (string) $result);

    private function emitScalarFormulaElement(string $cellValue): void
    {
        $objWriter = $this->formulaXmlWriter;
        if ($objWriter === null) {

        }
        $prefixed = self::addFunctionPrefixStripEquals($cellValue);
        $objWriter->writeElement('f', $prefixed);
        $writeValue = $this->office2003compatibility === false
            && $this->preCalculateFormulas
            && $this->calculatedValue !== null;
        if ($writeValue) {
            $cached = $this->calculatedValueString;
            if (!is_array($this->calculatedValue) && !str_starts_with($cached, '#')) {
                $value = StringHelper::formatNumber($cached);
            } else {
                $value = '0';

            $objWriter->writeElement('v', $value);
        }
    }

    private function emitFormulaCell(string $cellValue, Cell $cell): void
    {
        $objWriter = $this->formulaXmlWriter;
        if ($objWriter === null || $this->xlsxWriter === null) {
            return;
        }
        $attributes = $cell->getFormulaAttributes() ?? [];
        $this->formulaCoordinate = $cell->getCoordinate();
        $this->calculatedValue = $this->preCalculateFormulas ? $cell->getCalculatedValue() : $cellValue;
        if ($this->calculatedValue === ExcelError::SPILL()) {
            $this->emitSpillFormula($cellValue);

            return;
        }
        $this->calculatedValueString = $this->preCalculateFormulas ? $cell->getCalculatedValueString() : $cellValue;
        $status = $this->classifyFormulaResultType($cellValue);
        if ($status === 'error' || $status === 'skip') {
            return;
        }
        $ref = $this->resolveFormulaRef($attributes);
        $attributes = $this->normalizeFormulaAttributes($attributes);
        if (($attributes['t'] ?? null) === 'array') {
            $this->emitArrayFormulaElement($cellValue, $ref);
        } else {
            $this->emitScalarFormulaElement($cellValue);
        }
    }

    private function normalizeFormulaAttributes(array $attributes): array
    {

        }

    private function bindDefinedNameContext(XMLWriter $objWriter, Spreadsheet $spreadsheet): void

    private function resolveLocalSheetIndex(DefinedName $definedName): int
    {
        $this->definedNameLocalId = -1;
        if ($definedName->getLocalOnly() && $definedName->getScope() !== null) {
            try {
                $this->definedNameLocalId = $definedName->getScope()->getParentOrThrow()->getIndex($definedName->getScope());
            } catch (\Exception) {
                $this->definedNameLocalId = -2;
            }
        }

        return $this->definedNameLocalId;
    }

    private function quoteSheetTitle(string $title): string
    {
        $quoted = "'" . str_replace("'", "''", $title) . "'";
        if ($this->quotedSheetTitle !== $quoted) {
            $this->quotedSheetTitle = $quoted;
        }

        return $this->quotedSheetTitle;
    }

    private function rewriteDefinedRange(DefinedName $definedName): string
    {
        $definedRange = $definedName->getValue();
        $splitCount = preg_match_all(
            '/' . Calculation::CALCULATION_REGEXP_CELLREF_RELATIVE . '/mui',
            $definedRange,
            $splitRanges,
            PREG_OFFSET_CAPTURE
        );

        $matchedTokens = $splitRanges[0] ?? [];
        $lengths = array_map('strlen', array_column($matchedTokens, 0));
        $offsets = array_column($matchedTokens, 1);

        $worksheets = $splitRanges[2] ?? [];
        $columns = $splitRanges[6] ?? [];
        $rows = $splitRanges[7] ?? [];

        while ($splitCount > 0) {
            --$splitCount;
            $length = $lengths[$splitCount];
            $offset = $offsets[$splitCount];
            $worksheet = $worksheets[$splitCount][0];
            $column = $columns[$splitCount][0];
            $row = $rows[$splitCount][0];

            $newRange = '';
            if (empty($worksheet)) {
                $precededByRangeOperator = ($offset !== 0) && ($definedRange[$offset - 1] === ':');
                if ($offset === 0 || $precededByRangeOperator === false) {
                    $ws = $definedName->getWorksheet();
                    $worksheet = ($ws === null) ? null : $ws->getTitle();
                }
            } else {
                $worksheet = str_replace("''", "'", trim($worksheet, "'"));
            }

            if (!empty($worksheet)) {
                $newRange = $this->quoteSheetTitle((string) $worksheet) . '!';
            }
            $newRange = "{$newRange}{$column}{$row}";

            $prefix = substr($definedRange, 0, $offset);
            $suffix = substr($definedRange, $offset + $length);
            $definedRange = $prefix . $newRange . $suffix;
        }

        if (str_starts_with($definedRange, '=')) {
            $definedRange = substr($definedRange, 1);
        }
        $this->definedRangeBuffer = $definedRange;

        return $this->definedRangeBuffer;
    }

    private function emitNamedRange(DefinedName $definedName): void
    {
        $objWriter = $this->definedNameXmlWriter;
        if ($objWriter === null) {
            return;
        }
        $local = $this->resolveLocalSheetIndex($definedName);
        if ($local === -2) {
            return;
        }
        $name = $definedName->getName();
        $objWriter->startElement('definedName');
        $objWriter->writeAttribute('name', $name);
        if ($local >= 0) {
            $objWriter->writeAttribute(
                'localSheetId',
                "$local"
            );
        }
        $definedRange = $this->rewriteDefinedRange($definedName);
        $this->definedRangeBuffer = $definedRange;
        $objWriter->writeRawData($this->definedRangeBuffer);
        $objWriter->endElement();
    }

    private function emitAutofilterDefinedName(ActualWorksheet $worksheet, int $worksheetId = 0): void
    {
        $objWriter = $this->definedNameXmlWriter;

        }

        if (empty($autoFilterRange)) {

        $objWriter->startElement('definedName');

        $objWriter->writeAttribute('localSheetId', "$worksheetId");
        $objWriter->writeAttribute('hidden', '1');

        $range = $range[0];

        if (count($range) > 1) {
            $range[1] = Coordinate::absoluteCoordinate($range[1]);
        }
        $range = implode(':', $range);
        $this->definedRangeBuffer = $this->quoteSheetTitle($worksheet->getTitle()) . '!' . $range;

    private function emitPrintTitlesDefinedName(ActualWorksheet $worksheet, int $worksheetId = 0): void
    {

            $repeat = $worksheet->getPageSetup()->getColumnsToRepeatAtLeft();
            $settingString .= $quotedTitle . '!$' . $repeat[0] . ':$' . $repeat[1];
        }
        if ($worksheet->getPageSetup()->isRowsToRepeatAtTopSet()) {
            if ($worksheet->getPageSetup()->isColumnsToRepeatAtLeftSet()) {
                $settingString .= ',';
            }
            $repeat = $worksheet->getPageSetup()->getRowsToRepeatAtTop();
            $settingString .= $quotedTitle . '!$' . $repeat[0] . ':$' . $repeat[1];

    private function emitPrintAreaDefinedName(ActualWorksheet $worksheet, int $worksheetId = 0): void

            $printAreaRect[1] = Coordinate::absoluteReference($printAreaRect[1]);

    private function emitDataValidations(ActualWorksheet $worksheet): void
    {

    private function emitAllDefinedNames(): void
    {
        $objWriter = $this->definedNameXmlWriter;
        $spreadsheet = $this->definedNameSpreadsheet;
        if ($objWriter === null || $spreadsheet === null) {
            return;

        $objWriter->startElement('definedNames');

        for ($i = 0; $i < $sheetCount; ++$i) {

    private function bindAutoFilterContext(XMLWriter $objWriter): void
    {
        $this->autoFilterXmlWriter = $objWriter;
        $this->autoFilterRange = '';
        $this->filterColumnId = 0;

    private function normalizeAutoFilterRange(string $autoFilterRange): string
    {

        $range = $range[0];
        [$ws, $range[0]] = ActualWorksheet::extractSheetTitle($range[0], true);

    private function isBlankEqualFilterRule(Column $column, Rule $rule): bool
    {
        $this->filterRuleType = $rule->getRuleType();

        return ($column->getFilterType() === Column::AUTOFILTER_FILTERTYPE_FILTER)
            && ($rule->getOperator() === Rule::AUTOFILTER_COLUMN_RULE_EQUAL)
            && ($rule->getValue() === '');
    }

    private function emitDynamicFilterAttributes(Column $column, Rule $rule): void
    {
        $objWriter = $this->autoFilterXmlWriter;
        if ($objWriter === null) {
            return;
        }
        $this->filterRuleType = $rule->getRuleType();
        $objWriter->writeAttribute('type', $rule->getGrouping());
        $val = $column->getAttribute('val');
        if ($val !== null) {
            $objWriter->writeAttribute('val', "$val");
        }
        $maxVal = $column->getAttribute('maxVal');
        if ($maxVal !== null) {
            $objWriter->writeAttribute('maxVal', "$maxVal");
        }
    }

    private function emitTopTenFilterAttributes(Rule $rule): void
    {
        $objWriter = $this->autoFilterXmlWriter;
        if ($objWriter === null) {
            return;
        }
        $this->filterRuleType = $rule->getRuleType();
        $ruleValue = $rule->getValue();
        if (!is_array($ruleValue)) {
            $objWriter->writeAttribute('val', "$ruleValue");
        }
        $objWriter->writeAttribute('percent', (($rule->getOperator() === Rule::AUTOFILTER_COLUMN_RULE_TOPTEN_PERCENT) ? '1' : '0'));
        $objWriter->writeAttribute('top', (($rule->getGrouping() === Rule::AUTOFILTER_COLUMN_RULE_TOPTEN_TOP) ? '1' : '0'));
    }

    private function emitStandardFilterRule(Rule $rule): void
    {
        $objWriter = $this->autoFilterXmlWriter;
        if ($objWriter === null) {
            return;
        }
        $this->filterRuleType = $rule->getRuleType();
        $objWriter->startElement($rule->getRuleType());
        if ($rule->getOperator() !== Rule::AUTOFILTER_COLUMN_RULE_EQUAL) {
            $objWriter->writeAttribute('operator', $rule->getOperator());
        }
        if ($rule->getRuleType() === Rule::AUTOFILTER_RULETYPE_DATEGROUP) {
            $ruleValue = $rule->getValue();
            if (is_array($ruleValue)) {
                foreach ($ruleValue as $key => $value) {
                    $objWriter->writeAttribute($key, "$value");
                }
            }
            $objWriter->writeAttribute('dateTimeGrouping', $rule->getGrouping());
        } else {
            $ruleValue = $rule->getValue();
            if (!is_array($ruleValue)) {
                $objWriter->writeAttribute('val', "$ruleValue");
            }
        }
        $objWriter->endElement();
    }

    private function emitAutoFilterColumn(Column $column, int $colId): void
    {
        $objWriter = $this->autoFilterXmlWriter;
        if ($objWriter === null) {
            return;
        }
        $rules = $column->getRules();
        if (count($rules) === 0) {
            return;
        }
        $this->filterColumnId = $colId;
        $this->filterJoin = $column->getJoin();
        $filterType = $column->getFilterType();
        $objWriter->startElement('filterColumn');
        $objWriter->writeAttribute('colId', "$colId");
        $objWriter->startElement($filterType);
        if ($this->filterJoin == Column::AUTOFILTER_COLUMN_JOIN_AND) {
            $objWriter->writeAttribute('and', '1');
        }
        foreach ($rules as $rule) {
            $ruleType = $rule->getRuleType();
            if ($this->isBlankEqualFilterRule($column, $rule)) {
                $objWriter->writeAttribute('blank', '1');
            } elseif ($ruleType === Rule::AUTOFILTER_RULETYPE_DYNAMICFILTER) {
                $this->emitDynamicFilterAttributes($column, $rule);
            } elseif ($ruleType === Rule::AUTOFILTER_RULETYPE_TOPTENFILTER) {
                $this->emitTopTenFilterAttributes($rule);
            } else {
                $this->emitStandardFilterRule($rule);
            }
        }
        $objWriter->endElement();
        $objWriter->endElement();
    }

    private function emitWorksheetAutoFilter(ActualWorksheet $worksheet): void
    {
        $objWriter = $this->autoFilterXmlWriter;
        if ($objWriter === null) {
            return;
        }
        $autoFilter = $worksheet->getAutoFilter();
        $autoFilterRange = $autoFilter->getRange();
        if (empty($autoFilterRange)) {
            return;
        }
        $objWriter->startElement('autoFilter');
        $normalized = $this->normalizeAutoFilterRange($autoFilterRange);
        $objWriter->writeAttribute('ref', $normalized);
        $columns = $autoFilter->getColumns();
        if (count($columns) > 0) {
            foreach ($columns as $columnID => $column) {
                $colId = $autoFilter->getColumnOffset($columnID);
                $this->filterColumnId = $colId;
                $this->emitAutoFilterColumn($column, $colId);
            }
        }
        $objWriter->endElement();
    }

Confirmed the `DrawingsTest` failure pre-exists my change (missing GD extension in the environment).

**Fix applied**: Removed `'|sumifs'` from the Excel 2019 function list in `src/PhpSpreadsheet/Writer/Xlsx/FunctionPrefix.php:146`, since `SUMIFS` was introduced in Excel 2007 and must not receive the `_xlfn.` prefix when writing XLSX.

Verification:
- `FunctionPrefix::addFunctionPrefix('=SUMIFS(...)')` now returns the formula without `_xlfn.`
- `FunctionPrefixTest`, `ArrayFunctions2Test`, and `SumIfsTest` all pass (21 tests, 39 assertions)
